description: H100-SXM hourly panel (METHODOLOGY.md). Underlying: the H100 SXM5 80GB module on an HGX baseboard -- form-factor pure. 16 members, weight floor 2.5%, claim floor 5. Selection over the raw-observatory record; captures nothing.

calc.description: calc_v1 (panel genesis mint; METHODOLOGY.md is the binding methodology document -- this text is the summary; membership deltas are evidence-driven). The index and its weights recompute at EVERY hourly observation (rule A1); the fallback->dynamic switch adopts the 50% attendance floor (rule A2). RECORD: raw-observatory hourly snapshots from the 2026-08-23 genesis -- no basket era, no stitching. IDENTITY: rows select by stored sku, then the panel-level reject tokens screen pre-catalog-change history where variants were filed under the generic H100 sku, then each seat's variant rule fires (require_tokens on the structured sku_identifier, or declared with the provider-surface evidence quoted on the seat; fail closed -- a label that names no variant proves no variant and prints nothing). MEMBERSHIP DELTAS vs the draft seat list (probe 2026-08-23): sesterce OFF (its only H100 print is a 'From' floor across mixed 'SXM5 / PCIe' configs -- not SXM-attributable); digitalocean ON (second-wave 'seat on confirmation' met: its pricing page names the product 'NVIDIA HGX H100' at the collector's exact print). MARKETPLACE STATISTICS (METHODOLOGY.md section 7): vast prices via vast_vwm_verified_us_ca_floor (population-accounting gate + floors: >= 5 distinct machines AND >= 3 distinct hosts, else held out thin_book with counts -- live probe 2026-08-23 found the verified-US/CA H100-SXM book was 3 machines on ONE host); lium via lium_vwm_book_floor (volume = machine gpu_count; floors >= 5 machines AND >= 3 distinct miner hotkeys; NO verified screen exists on lium and no geo screen is applied -- both recorded open methodology calls). NO parity leg: no predecessor series exists for this instrument. TIER SCREEN: eligibility is the ALLOW-LIST calc.eligible_tiers, on-demand only -- methodology section 5 as written, replacing the exclusion-list interruptible_tiers screen (which had grown 'serverless' for verda's serverless-SPOT rows: tier 'serverless' priced 45% under its on-demand rate at probe 2026-08-24T00Z; the allow-list screens those and every other non-on-demand tier mechanically -- a serverless GPU-second is also a different underlying, the recorded fal-exclusion rationale). This mint RECONCILES the methodology section 15 committed-tier limitation: hyperstack's reserved 'Starting from' floor and together's reserved tenors never print here, and gmicloud's from_floor rows remain out by tier (the frozen daily B300/B200 series kept committed/reserved eligible; this panel has no daily predecessor). MEMBER EXTRA SCREEN: runpod's record carries Secure AND Community cloud rows under one structured label, distinguished only by the collector's extra.cloud field -- the seat's extra_require admits cloud 'secure' only. OPEN METHODOLOGY CALLS (recorded): lium population definition and both marketplace floor values (chosen priors); window/warm-up/confirm counts span hours (20h/10h/3h). Any param change touching a published calc_v1 observation mints calc_v2. AMENDED INTO THIS MINT BEFORE ANY OBSERVATION PUBLISHED (perf review 2026-08-23): (a) drift_scan_observations moved out of calc to a TOP-LEVEL operational key -- the drift-scan bound gates an ops sweep, never the series bytes (the fallback_parity_methodology_id precedent), so it no longer rides calc_params under the D2 fence, and the scan runs on the 16:00Z firing (or --drift-scan) instead of every firing; (b) replay is BOUNDED: state rebuilds from the trailing state window (dw history + max forward horizon + prune margin -- the weight-state prune bound, inside which every consulted state fully rebuilds) behind the publish frontier, seeded by the latest pre-window artifact for the weight-mode latch and the D2 baseline, and the manual-exclusion pin check covers published artifacts inside that window only (older artifacts are immutable; their pins were enforced when the frontier passed them); (c) the ECB feed is fetched only when an unpublished observation day cannot resolve a stored rate after walk-back (stored FX reads bounded to the window plus the staleness allowance). AMENDED INTO THIS MINT BEFORE ANY OBSERVATION PUBLISHED (harden review 2026-08-23): (d) the fallback->dynamic switch quorum additionally requires a NON-EMPTY attendance-passer set -- with zero passers (every candidate below the attendance floor, a lane-wide outage's aftermath) the every-passer-has-Q clause is vacuously true and one post-outage observation could have flipped the PERMANENT latch on zero attendance information, inverting the A2 intent; genesis is unaffected (a zero-scheduled window makes every candidate a passer at ratio 1.0); (e) row eligibility fails closed on NON-FINITE prices: a candidate row must carry a finite native price (and a finite USD price when one is present) or it is excluded and counted (screen_counts non_finite_price) -- json admits NaN/Infinity literals and non-USD rows skip the capture-side USD plausibility band, so a non-finite native could otherwise poison the lowest-eligible min; capture-side normalization now also flags non-finite natives implausible (flag-only, future snapshots only); (f) a new top-level record_exclusions key ([{date, hour, reason}]) quarantines a poisoned/unparseable record object at an unpublished stamp: the observation publishes an explicit record_quarantined artifact (index null, observation_missed false) WITHOUT reading the record -- instead of the lane wedging forever behind publish-in-order -- and the key rides calc_params, pinned per published observation exactly like manual_exclusions. Artifact-visibility hardening in the same review: silent ok-status seats pin eligible_rows plus per-screen screen_counts (a seat whose rows ALL screen out is distinguishable from one with no rows at all -- the dead-seat tripwire), and an observation_missed artifact publishes only after a confirming FRESH re-LIST of the slot keys (a transient empty LIST must never pin an immutable false missed record).
